1. (Currently amended) A dynamic laminar structure, for example for working tools and machines, comprising a lamination of first and second outer layers and __at least one medial section__, the structure comprising first and second layers, __a first adhesive layer positioned between the first layer and the medial section__, __a second adhesive layer positioned between the medial section and the second layer__, the first and second layers having a circular shape and including a plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments having an inner arc shape and an outer arc shape, wherein the inner arc shape of each of the arc-shaped cutting segments is directly affixed to an outer perimeter of the first and second layers, __wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are positioned on opposite sides of the medial section__ and the first layer and the second layer are __positioned adjacent to__ the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer respectively.

2. (Currently amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 281, wherein the medial section comprises a metal.

3. (Currently amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 282, wherein the metal is a honeycomb structure.

4. (Currently amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 282, wherein the medial section is a composite material.

5. (Currently amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 281, further including a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers.

6. (Currently amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 285, wherein the weld ring is bonded to the medial section.

7. (Currently amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 285, wherein the plurality of cutting segments are also welded to an outer perimeter of the weld ring.

8. (Currently amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 285, wherein the weld ring is continuous.

9. (Currently amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 285, further including an inner ring, wherein the medial section is coupled on an inner perimeter to the inner ring, wherein the inner ring includes __a__ central opening for accommodating a drive shaft.

10. (Currently amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 290, wherein the inner ring includes __a__ central opening for accommodating a drive shaft.

11. (Currently amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 281, further including a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers and the plurality of cutting segments, such that the plurality of cutting segments are located on an outer periphery of the weld ring, wherein the weld ring is continuous __and segmented__.

12. (Currently amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 293, wherein the weld ring is segmented into a plurality of discrete segments.
